column4: A single small toolbar button icon for a 1998 city-building PC game like SimCity 2000 and RollerCoaster Tycoon: pixel art drawn large with crisp square pixels, dark outline, bright but slightly muted 1990s colours, three-quarter view, centred, filling 80 percent of the canvas. Background must be flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere around it, no text, no border. The icon shows: a small boxy grey 1990s video camera (camcorder) with a round lens and a red record light, standing on two short cartoon legs with little brown shoes, mid-stride as if walking to the left.
